module.description: The ToastRegion renderer and its options.
module.name: toast-region

ui.guidance: One per document, rendered in the shell and outside #content: navigation swaps only #content, so a region inside it would be destroyed mid-swap and lose both its queued toasts and its document listener. The live-region semantics sit on the container rather than on each toast, because a live region has to exist before its message arrives or nothing is announced. Its Alpine controller (toastRoot) is registered by the shell in static/app.js: the shell owns the HX-Trigger listener and the flash handoff across a redirect.
ui.name: toast-region
ui.summary: Renders the shell's live toast stack.
